accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: The canonical certificate bound, minimum-output theorem, infeasibility procedure, and local compiler are conditional on an affirmative resolution of the uniform source-certificate normal form.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: Exact physical acquisition optimization and FPT infeasibility are claimed conditional on proving the uniform one-source-per-factor normal form within the stated measured-ancestry scope.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: CTFIDU+ takes a graph, an unnested query, and supplied input distribution specifications, and is sound and complete for identification from that fixed set.
The paper defines realizability and gives a complete procedure for determining whether an arbitrary counterfactual distribution can be sampled under physical constraints.

For a connected target district, Theorem 1 gives a singleton reduction; Lemma 3 equates the optimum with weighted hitting set over hedges; Theorem 2 gives a polynomial reduction from weighted minimum vertex cover and hence NP-hardness.

The journal paper studies minimum-cost collections of interventions for causal-effect identification, proves NP-completeness, and gives exact and logarithmic-approximation algorithms through minimum hitting set.
The paper reformulates ordinary proxy experiment design for faster computation and adjustment-set design; it does not state physical counterfactual protocol semantics.

source_verification_receipts.locator: p. 3, §3 'On the Positivity Assumption in G-Identifiability'
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper requires positivity of the observational joint distribution P(V) for all observed realizations in g-identifiability and explains that without it conditional quantities can be undefined.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Add a statement-level comparison with AkbariEtesamiKiyavash2025Optimal, explicitly separating its ordinary intervention object, source-family semantics, complexity result, and approximation guarantee from the physical protocol object here.

Retag positive-source-law as a novel Layer-2.5 slice-positivity condition and state the precise admissible conditioning events it covers, with a physical-design justification rather than the gID citation.

Demote one-action-cover to a corollary and replace it as a novelty claim with a nontrivial protocol-synergy boundary, such as a necessary-and-sufficient condition for the set-cover reduction or a hardness obstruction outside it.

Resolve the uniform-normal-form OEQ on a restricted nontrivial graph family or provide an explicit finite counterexample; this is the shortest route from a conditional field programme to a proved algorithmic contribution.

recommended_next_step: Revise the literature comparison and positivity assumption, demote the routine set-cover corollary, and retain the uniform-source normal form as the load-bearing Stage-0 target.
